question: Gorakhpur is the headquarter of ______ Railway in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**North-Eastern**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The North Eastern Railway (NER) is one of the 18 railway zones in India, headquartered in **Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The NER was formed on 14th April 1952 by combining two railway systems - **the Oudh and Tirhut Railway and Assam Railway.**
 
• The NER covers a large part of North India, including the states of **Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Bihar, and parts of West Bengal**.
 
• The zone has a total route length of over 3,400 kilometers and covers some of the busiest railway stations in India, such as **Lucknow, Varanasi, and Gorakhpur**.
 
• The NER operates both passenger and freight trains, with a focus on improving connectivity in the region.
 
• The zone has introduced several initiatives to improve the passenger experience, including the introduction of modern trains and coaches, improved catering services, and the installation of digital display boards at stations.
